services.name: Contemporary Art Bus Tour
services.desc: Join us for a free guided bus tour to explore serendipitous, intersecting curatorial ideas and artists’ works between current exhibitions at the Art Museum at the University of Toronto, The Power Plant Contemporary Art Gallery, and The Joan and Martin Goldfarb Gallery of York University. The bus tour begins at the Art Museum with Earthwork, an exhibition that redresses 1960s land art by considering multiple histories and layers of engagement with the earth through an Indigenous lens. The tour continues to Dwelling Under Distant Suns, where artists explore the entanglement between climate, the environment, and geopolitics. At The Power Plant, we will visit two solo exhibitions: Jeneen Frei
